id: Funk The Band, Yawner, Louie Flack-San Fran, Wellington-Ticket Master
name: Funk The Band, Yawner, Louie Flack
long_description:
FRENZ PRESENTS: Funk The Band, Yawner, Louie Flack.
Join us at San Fran on August 7th for a night filled with Funk, R&B, Jazz and House.

Funk The Band are a Wellington based group whose performance is guaranteed to entertain. They’re a fantastic force that blend a sweet mixture of classic soul funk and new-age jazz fusion. After their debut show in late 2025, they have been honing in their craft and getting ready to burn down the house.
Yawner is a R&B/Alternative project hailing from Wellington, New Zealand, led by Eden Brown (vocals) and Jamin Forlong (guitar). Formed in late 2024, the group has honed a sound that’s rooted in R&B, indie and jazz, and has now unveiled their work in two studio singles ‘Subside’ and 'Monkey Say' ahead of their forthcoming 2026 EP. Focusing on a heavy-hitting but soothing craft, they’ve organised an enormous live set which is not to be missed.
Growing up around a lot of music at both festivals and at home naturally Louie Flack has become infatuated with the idea of the floor, posturing himself as a slightly obsessive collector of music. As much as Louie’s collection centers a hefty amount of house music, he also plays soul, raregroove, jazz, disco, afrobeat, world and synth based music like post punk and Italo disco.

San Fran holds a Supervised License. Minors are welcome to attend events at San Fran so long as they are accompanied by a legal guardian at all times whilst at the venue.

id: Home Brew | Last Week AUS/NZ Tour-Shed 6, Wellington-Ticket Master
name: Home Brew | Last Week AUS/NZ Tour
long_description:
Home Brew are one of Aotearoa’s most beloved hip-hop groups, rising to equal parts greatness and infamy through their extensive run of EPs through the early 2010s and culminating in their now-classic #1 self-titled debut. The band re-entered the charts with their brand-new album Run It Back in 2023, securing them a raft of new fans.
Their aggressively DIY ethos has endeared them to many in the New Zealand Hip-Hop music scene, and they have cemented their place in history as one of the country's most authentic, uncompromising acts.
Following the overwhelming response to their sold-out Auckland Town Hall performance earlier this year, audiences across Australia and New Zealand will now experience one of Aotearoa's defining hip-hop releases performed live in full, alongside the songs that have shaped the band's enduring legacy.
TICKETS GO ON SALE THURSDAY 30 JULY AT 2PM LOCAL TIME
Mastercard Presale Tuesday 28 July, 1pm – Thursday 30 July, 1pm (local time)
Westpac Mastercard Presale Tuesday 28 July, 1pm – Thursday 30 July, 1pm (local time)
Live Nation Presale Wednesday 29 July, 1pm – Thursday 30 July, 1pm (local time)
For complete tour and ticket information, visit: livenation.com.au and livenation.co.nz.

id: Old Mervs Carparks AU + NZ Tour-San Fran, Wellington-Ticket Master
name: Old Mervs Carparks AU + NZ Tour
long_description:
Australia's favourite indie-rock duo Old Mervs are hitting the road to play their biggest capacity venues yet, celebrating the release of sophomore album Carparks. This October and November, Dave and Henry will play a string of shows across Australia and New Zealand, stepping up into rooms including Melbourne's Forum and Sydney's Enmore Theatre for the first time.
 The tour comes hot on the heels of Carparks official release date of Friday 2 October. Reuniting with producer Chris Collins (Royel Otis, Ruby Fields, Matt Corby), fans have already received tastes of what’s to come with singles "Heavy In The Morning", "Tether" and latest track "She Said”.
 Dave and Henry said “We cannot wait to get rolling into this tour. There are heaps of bucket list venues on this run and to get to play this album in them feels bloody good. It's been a while between headline Australian shows so we are amped to get into it!”
 Don't miss your chance to see Old Mervs bring Carparks to life, along with old favourites - in the biggest rooms of their career so far.

id: Buckshot with Sidney Phillips, Oscar18 -San Fran, Wellington-Ticket Master
name: Buckshot with Sidney Phillips, Oscar18
long_description:
Irish artist Buckshot is bringing his unmistakable sound across Australia/New Zealand this fall. With over 3 million monthly listeners and the release of his latest project, INDIGO CHILD, Buckshot continues to build momentum as one of the most exciting names in the underground scene.
Following a completely sold-out European tour earlier this year, Buckshot returns to the continent with a run of summer festival appearances and headline shows, delivering the dark, cult-followed sound that has earned him a dedicated global fanbase.
